text: {"assertions":["A latency spike was identified in ml/serving/batcher.py that only manifested after a client retry.","The root cause of the latency spike was an off-by-one error in the slice bound logic.","The spike was detected as a tail far above the median in the serving histogram.","The fix involved correcting the slice bound and adding a property test to prevent regression.","The fix was submitted as PR #3194 on branch fix/latency-spike-1.","The latency spike could be reproduced using a mixed-size request trace.","The fix eliminated 56 duplicate rows per day from being written to the system.","This work was a continuation of earlier latency spike investigation efforts in the same file."]}
